item.title: My robot will pay for that in crypto, thank you very much!

item.title: Trump’s Gallipoli

item.title: [Planet Labs] Three Days, 30%!
item.description: It’s official — Planet Labs (PL) is in breakout mode! It broke out to all-time highs overnight – and three days ago, we named it during our Tech Turning Point event with James in San Jose, California.

item.title: Stopped out of BM8, and a word on tactics as energy comes into focus

item.title: The Grand Fusion Cycle is Underway — And Most Investors Are Still Asleep
item.description: Today, we embark on a great undertaking. We take a giant step back from the daily headlines. And make an effort to form a strategy that will benefit five years from now…not five months from now.
